=== bm1684x ===
commit 4ab63b3c2e

=== bm1688 ===
commit 0994e837c0ab01c449de55b7f4365b5063287444
Author: yujia liu <yujia.liu@sophgo.com>
Date:   Tue Aug 11 10:33:34 2026 +0800

fix: support matmul+relu do_relu on bm1688

Extend the bm1684x matmul+relu fix to the bm1686 architecture (bm1688):
pass do_relu through the api and enable the fused per-channel requant
path (graceful-drop + requant_via_int16). Keep bias_dtype as FP32 on
bm1686 so the fp16 matmul path is unaffected.

Keep bm1688's native with_rq1 fast path (requant_mode<0/2/5, no izp)
for non-fused matmul, and keep its rzp_dtype as DT_INT16 (as before):
excluding bm1686 from with_rq1 or switching rzp to the input dtype both
broke bm1688 int8 matmul (wrong bmodel output / codegen crash). The
fused do_relu path (requant_mode==3) is unaffected.

Change-Id: I292db1a970000000000000000000000000000001
=== cv184x ===
commit b853c35aa6bbc6aa37676607bae9c94429694664
Author: yifan.chen <yifan.chen@sophgo.com>
Date:   Wed Jul 29 15:31:55 2026 +0800

    fix: handle non-integer offset in bm1684x2 requant mode==1
    
    - mode==1 perlayer path on BM1684X2/SG2262 now checks offset integrality;
      non-integer offset falls back to fp32 arithmetic (cast to FP32, fp_mul_C,
      fp_add_C, cast to top) so the fractional part participates in final rounding
    - global layer allocates FP32 buffer for mode==1 + non-integer offset on
      BM1684X2/SG2262, enabling the local-layer fallback
    
    Change-Id: I4cdbf568bae3501e5eba768a7faaf8ca21709c3d

fix: support matmul+relu do_relu on bm1688

Extend the bm1684x matmul+relu fix to the bm1686 architecture (bm1688):
pass do_relu through the api and enable the fused per-channel requant
path (graceful-drop + requant_via_int16). Keep bias_dtype as FP32 on
bm1686 so the fp16 matmul path is unaffected.

Keep bm1688's native with_rq1 fast path (requant_mode<0/2/5, no izp)
for non-fused matmul, and keep its rzp_dtype as DT_INT16 (as before):
excluding bm1686 from with_rq1 or switching rzp to the input dtype both
broke bm1688 int8 matmul (wrong bmodel output / codegen crash). The
fused do_relu path (requant_mode==3) is unaffected.
